scope: Incremental launch-film tools beyond capability-catalog.json; real demos, founder integration, spatial UI, minimalist motion graphics and finishing.
readiness_policy: Research verifies sources and licensing signals only. Nothing was installed, benchmarked, purchased or connected by this task.

recommended_small_core.capture: Playwright for repeatable real browser demos; OBS if desktop/camera capture is needed.
recommended_small_core.composition: Existing Remotion with frame-based typography, spacing and motion tokens.
recommended_small_core.spatial_ui: Add Three.js + R3F + only necessary Drei helpers through @remotion/three for shots that benefit from depth.
recommended_small_core.founder: Use approved real recording or the already authorized own-avatar workflow; preserve pronunciation and a natural speaking rhythm.
recommended_small_core.sound_and_delivery: Existing FFmpeg/QA and editing route; Resolve/Fairlight only when specialist finishing is warranted.

entries.name: microsoft/playwright
entries.use_in_launch_film: Script actual product interactions in a controlled browser, capture real UI and retain repeatable action scripts.
entries.model_weights_license: not_applicable_to_library; content, example assets and services may have separate terms
notes: Configure viewport and recording size explicitly; default recording may be scaled down.
Use a staging/demo account with authorized test data. Finalize the browser context so its video is saved.
Video recording is evidence of UI behaviour; do not pass an interactive mockup off as a shipped feature.
